purpose: Reviewable parent-scope reconciliation and evidence index; not a runtime contract, provider discovery result or release proof.

implementation_baseline.historical_receipts: Each checkpoint receipt identifies its exact tested implementation and environment; inclusion does not requalify all features on this baseline.

acceptance_wording_policy: Original #13 acceptance order and wording, with canonical lowercase product names.

acceptance_items.original_item: A versioned audio-analysis schema and normalized provider-neutral model exist.
acceptance_items.limitations: Metadata parsing checks consistency, not media bytes, authenticity or real analyzer correctness.

acceptance_items.original_item: Technical, musical, transcript/timed-text, MIDI, and stem-aware capability boundaries are explicit.
acceptance_items.limitations: Family identifiers and representation limits do not imply installed providers or every media profile.

acceptance_items.original_item: At least one deterministic offline technical analyzer is integrated.
acceptance_items.limitations: Admitted PCM16 WAV only; no arbitrary codecs or generalized container clocks.

acceptance_items.original_item: Tempo/beat and key estimates carry confidence and provider evidence.
acceptance_items.limitations: Native raw scores and disagreement retained; calibrated confidence explicitly unavailable. Actual synthetic Essentia observations in the historical receipt do not prove arbitrary-music accuracy.

acceptance_items.original_item: Reviewed lyrics remain distinct from observed transcription.
acceptance_items.limitations: Supplied review declarations are not independently authenticated; alignment timing remains candidate evidence.

acceptance_items.original_item: Timed-text conversions report preserved and lost semantics.
acceptance_items.limitations: Registered subsets only; named losses cannot manufacture timing or authorize arbitrary syntax.

acceptance_items.original_item: MIDI outputs remain probabilistic candidates with provenance.
acceptance_items.limitations: Activation is not calibrated confidence, inferred instrument or authored-score authority. Actual learned-model inference/accuracy remains unverified.

acceptance_items.original_item: #8 stem artifacts can participate without coupling analysis to Demucs.
acceptance_items.limitations: Accepted stage and immutable artifact identity are consumed; relationship contents remain opaque. Duration agreement does not establish phase/onset alignment.

acceptance_items.original_item: All external execution is bounded, cancellable, and offline-policy aware.
acceptance_items.limitations: Unix process-group profile only. Direct execution, clean environments and private staging are not OS sandboxing or full native dependency closure.

acceptance_items.original_item: Structured unavailability explains missing tools/models rather than silently degrading.
acceptance_items.limitations: Missing dependencies can refuse before run creation; no successful unavailable-analysis artifact is promised for every preflight failure.

acceptance_items.original_item: Outputs have ordered timing, validation, digests, and resume-compatible provenance.
acceptance_items.limitations: Run-local compatible resume only, with mutable dependency reobservation. #32/#33/#34 remain broader timing/validation/reuse gates.

acceptance_items.original_item: Synthetic fixtures require no paid API or live model download.
acceptance_items.limitations: Synthetic provider conformance is distinct from actual learned-model inference, accuracy, native-platform support and releases.

acceptance_items.original_item: Documentation explains consumption by renderflow Sonic DNA and orchestration by flow.
acceptance_items.limitations: Consumer guidance only. Concrete renderflow uncertainty mapping remains #397; the released aniflow adapter in flow remains flow #51.

acceptance_items.original_item: Formatting, tests, docs, and CI pass.
acceptance_items.limitations: Required local formatting, naming, strict lint, Rust tests and complete synthetic smoke passed on the recorded implementation; relevant docs/contract checks also passed. The active parent local-check/review discipline accepts this bounded local evidence while hosted CI remains unverified. No hosted-CI or release pass is inferred.

semantics: Representation bounds are not analyzer support claims.
Validated parse checks source, scope, time, ordering, cross-references and outcome consistency.
Artifact references identify bytes; they do not grant paths, fetch authority or authenticity.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic model/schema conformance; no standalone media or model execution.

dependencies: Explicit absolute FFmpeg/ffprobe paths, exact SemVer version tokens and SHA-256 pins
boundary.scope: full source or full selected accepted stem

semantics: Independently observed RIFF/PCM identities must agree with ffprobe metadata and FFmpeg decoded PCM digest.
PCM bitrate is sample rate times channels times 16, distinct from container bitrate.
Source-time excerpt references do not render media previews.
profiles.qualification: Historical Linux local FFmpeg/ffprobe execution on generated PCM; native macOS/other builds and public release remain unverified.

true_peak.higher_rate_method: explicit fourfold SWR interpolation and floating-point peak scan

semantics: Quantities have separate units and definitions; loudness range is not crest factor.
Unqualified gated/silent/short-source measurements retain explicit unavailability, making normalized analysis partial.
Clipping-threshold crossings do not prove audible distortion or clipping history.
v1 remains frozen readable history; new execution emits the v2 companion.
profiles.qualification: Generated PCM and historical qualified high-rate fixture evidence; other FFmpeg/OS builds and native macOS remain unverified.

semantics: Original mix remains --input; observations and events use the selected stem's own clock.
Opaque accepted relationship-evidence bytes are not parsed as Demucs-native JSON.
Every declared stem must still satisfy admitted media, identity and duration checks, including unselected stems.
No executable separator or model installation is needed to import accepted retained output.
Use each workflow's exported final analysis to retain attached lineage.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic #8-compatible and independent separator evidence; actual model quality and onset alignment unverified.

boundary.algorithm: Essentia 2.1b6.dev1389 RhythmExtractor2013 multifeature and KeyExtractor krumhansl/temperley
boundary.preprocessing: PCM scale conversion and explicit arithmetic stereo mean only

semantics: Tempo, beats and key/mode are heuristic estimates with native scores and competing observations retained.
Calibrated confidence is unavailable; native estimator strengths are not probabilities.
Ready dependencies plus unsupported rate, insufficient duration or silent downmix can produce accepted unavailable musical evidence with partial analysis.
profiles.qualification: Historical actual selected Essentia execution on generated clicks/triads is retained in #46 receipt; this is limited fixture evidence, not arbitrary-music accuracy or native-platform qualification.

semantics: Probabilistic observed segment text remains distinct from reviewed lyrics.
Selected English language evidence is not language detection.
Word timing and segment calibrated confidence are explicitly unavailable.
Empty observations contain no invented timed-text cue.
Unsupported rate/channels or silent supported PCM can retain unavailable transcription and partial normalized analysis.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic configured provider/model identities only; actual whisper/model inference, recognition quality and native-platform qualification remain unverified.

semantics: Exact reviewed input bytes, supplied review/revision identity and cue text remain immutable.
Candidate word/cue timing never verifies that supplied words occur in the audio.
Unmatched or ambiguous words retain explicit state; cues without complete timing remain untimed or partial.
Missing dictionary words are not silently rewritten.
No calibrated correctness score or independent review authentication is inferred.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic configured provider/model conformance only; actual PocketSphinx/model inference and alignment quality, especially singing, remain unverified.

semantics: Candidate note activation remains native strength, not calibrated confidence.
Timing conversion/quantization and velocity/instrument/channel/tempo serialization mappings are explicit in export evidence.
Polyphony is valid, but same-pitch ambiguous overlap is refused.
Empty candidates and unavailable results produce partial normalized analysis with unavailable MIDI capability.
Explicit empty candidate export may succeed with no note events and empty_candidate true; this does not establish silence.
Unavailable results are not exported and authored MIDI is never an overwrite target.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic provider/adapter conformance and independently read-back SMF evidence; actual Basic Pitch/model inference and musical accuracy remain unverified.

boundary.timing: reduced rational seconds on millisecond grid, with untimed/point/interval cues

semantics: Preserve supplied text, provenance and optional audio binding; do not infer timing or review.
Named loss permissions authorize declared normalized field losses only.
Validate ordering/bounds/overlap independently of format carrier parsing.
Conversion report is published last; directory itself is not an atomic rename.
profiles.qualification: Synthetic Unicode/format/loss/roundtrip conformance only; no audio inference or review authentication.

status_semantics.meaning: Required structural execution/artifact checks completed for the declared profile; heuristic/probabilistic facts remain estimates.
Useful accepted output exists alongside explicit unavailable quantities/mappings; inspect reasons rather than replacing missing values with zero.
A completed workflow may retain valid technical evidence and honest unavailable optional analysis; do not invent BPM, transcript cues or notes.
Missing/stale dependencies return structured diagnostics and may prevent run creation. A successful unavailable-analysis artifact is not promised for every dependency refusal.
Recovery and accepted earlier checkpoints are retained when available; incomplete current-stage output is never accepted as complete.
Resume through the owning feature entry point reobserves source, settings and mutable dependency identities before compatible run-local reuse.
status-v3 inspects persisted evidence; it does not recheck the currently installed tools/models.
Package without its final conversion.json or export-report.json completion marker is incomplete; verify marker and companion artifact identities.

explicit_dispositions.source: Active #13 checkpoint plan assigned the support matrix to #46; merged #46 public companion retains fixed unsupported_families.
Each admitted optional profile explicitly retains native scores/activation separately from unavailable calibrated confidence.
Selected #48 whisper.cpp English segment profile; richer timing requires separately qualified profile.
Synthetic configured providers prove contract behavior, not actual whisper/PocketSphinx/Basic Pitch inference or media accuracy.
Declared Unix process-group execution does not imply tested native macOS or other builds; non-Unix executing audio profiles are unsupported.
Active #13/#51 local-check/review discipline explicitly says not to wait for or repeatedly poll hosted CI; fresh local evidence is recorded separately.
Source-time excerpt references are implemented; preview rendering and generalized mappings are separate product work.

downstream_gates.scope: Generalized rational stream identity, nonzero/negative clocks, stream selection and A/V mappings.
Layered component/stage/master/delivery acceptance gates beyond provider-owned analysis evidence.
Cross-run content-addressed reuse, invalidation, storage/retention/concurrency controls.
Broader generator-first adversarial corpus closeout; #51 indexes existing audio fixture coverage only.
Independently installable release qualification/publication after preceding gates.
Actual uncertainty-aware audio evidence mapping into renderflow Sonic DNA; consumer documentation is not implementation.
Concrete independently installable aniflow adapter and suite orchestration; no sibling source dependency or adapter implementation here.

completion.parent_close_condition: All #51 acceptance evidence reconciled, final local validation recorded and maintainer review/merge completed; parent does not close merely because the matrix exists.
